descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · S17 Existing specs (mocked model): Save & Extract closes exactly what the extractor returns, stores a proposed task across a reload, and keeps the notes with a retry message when task extraction fails

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Save & Extract closes the open tasks whose results are dictated in ordinary phrasing ('BMP came back, creatinine 1.1'; 'PT saw her, walking with a walker'). … (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U4 The task whose result is not dictated ('recheck weight in two weeks') stays open (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U5 A conditional order ('advance diet to clears if pain stays under 4') becomes a task (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U8 All of the above in Nursing Home as well as Hospital, passing in both (UAT TC-22 step 4; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U14 When task extraction fails or is slow, the physician sees a visible in-progress state and then a clear message and can retry (or the backup model answers, recorded per 3.9); … (UAT 3.5; UAT OAT-03)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Tim's specs with the extractor mocked: a resident with 'Recheck INR' and 'PT evaluation' (snf-save-extract.spec.ts); a Hospital patient whose extractor returns one task (encounter-workflow.spec.ts); a Hospital patient whose extractTasks call fails once (medication-detection.spec.ts, trackActionRequests failFirst)

When Run the three tests by exact title

Then Nursing Home: '✓ Tasks updated — 1 completed, 2 added'; INR done, PT open, the model's task and the codeword task stored. Hospital: the proposed task shown and stored after a reload. Hospital with a failed extraction: an alert that task extraction failed with 'Tap again to retry', the notes saved and the medication update kept

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions. Evidence for the app's half of U2/U4/U5 in both contexts and the Hospital message of U14; not evidence that the model matches results to tasks (S04/S05), and nothing here checks the Nursing Home failure path, that tasks are left unchanged by a failure, the retry or the double tap (S26)

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S17 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-22.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane A).

  • encounter-workflow.spec.ts [chromium] — Save & Extract persists a model-extracted action item — expected
  • medication-detection.spec.ts [chromium] — Save & Extract keeps medication updates when task extraction fails — expected
  • snf-save-extract.spec.ts [chromium] — Save & Extract saves the notes, closes and adds tasks, and keeps a codeword task verbatim — expected

This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
